thread:
carla: hey team — need to land PR #30112 before the deploy blackout on Fri. I'm blocked on a flaky mac e2e that keeps failing in CI. can anyone spare quick eyes? :eyes:
ben: pinging @dave and @eva — i can take a look in ~30m if no one else is free. what's the exact failure?
dave: i can jump in now. carla, can you paste the failing test output? also did you try a fresh rebase against main?
carla: i rebased an hour ago. CI shows this on the mac job:```
--- FAIL: TestSessionStore (0.12s)
    session_store_test.go:87: expected cookie to persist, got nil
--- FAIL: TestAuthFlow (0.05s)
```
looks nondeterministic — sometimes passes locally after `make test-e2e-mac`.
eva: fwiw, there's an infra rollout that changed the simulator image yesterday, might be related. infra-bot/merge-bot: Deploy blackout scheduled: Fri 22:00 - Sat 02:00 UTC.
ben: ok timeline: if we want this before blackout we need green CI + 1 approver by Thu EOD. can we do a small fallback in PR that removes flaky assertion as a temporary guard?
carla: i don't love removing assertions. alternative: add retry wrapper around session check for up to 200ms — low risk and unblocks. i can open a tiny followup patch if we want to land main fast and then ship a proper fix.
dave: i looked at logs, seems race with cookie set timing on mac sim only. retry should be fine. can you add a brief comment and a unit test for retry case? that'll make the change defensible.
carla: will add retry + comment + test now. tagging @eva for final approval after CI.
eva: great. i'll queue a review once CI is green. if mac still flakes, can we opt to land to dedicated canary pool (lower risk) and promote after a stable run?
ben: yes that's an option — schedule a canary rollout via `routes: canary=10%` in the rollout config. reach out to platform if you want me to route it.
carla: pushed patch with retry and test. CI re-run started: https://ci.internal/runs/98321
dave: left a couple tiny comments. nothing blocking. :thumbsup:
eva: approving now. CI green on linux/windows, mac still in progress. if mac passes in next run, proceed to merge before blackout.
carla: thanks all. if mac flakes again, we'll fallback to canary approach and schedule a short post-freeze follow-up to root cause. filing a quick issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4123
merge-bot: PR #30112 merged to main at 1719810490 (merge-by: carla).
